description: FREE. Submit the transaction hash of the customer's real payment for a bridge quote. N9T2 verifies it on-chain against the quote (exact amount, asset, recipient, expiry) and, once verified, executes the cross-chain delivery through its exactly-once worker. Resubmitting the same quote_id and hash returns the existing record. Verification is not completion: follow up with n9t2_bridge_receipt.

transaction_hash.description: Hash of the customer's actual source-chain payment for that quote. Never a planned or fabricated hash.
transaction_hash.title: Transaction Hash

name: n9t2_bridge_submit_payment
